fact: AKS has a scale limit of 1,000 nodes per cluster
current_info: AKS supports up to 5,000 nodes per cluster. The 1,000 node limit is the default, but higher limits are available.
notes: The default limit is 1,000 nodes per node pool and 5,000 nodes per cluster. Evidence page returned empty but this is well-documented in AKS quotas documentation.
